title: 1988 AMC 8 Problem 18
statement: The average weight of \(6\) boys is \(150\) pounds and the average weight of \(4\) girls is \(120\) pounds. The average weight of the \(10\) children is

solutions.text:
The total weight is \(6 \times 150\) \(+ 4 \times 120\) \(= 900 + 480\) \(= 1380\) pounds.

The average of the \(10\) children is \(\dfrac{1380}{10} = 138\) pounds.

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Find the total weight of the boys and the total weight of the girls separately
Divide the combined total weight by \(10\)
